z-m-13-05.s.s1.r.e: Nokuba kukho imizekelo emininzi echanekileyo, awukwazi ukuqiniseka ngo-"onke". Kufuneka isizathu sokuba kutheni isebenza.
z-m-13-05.s.s1.explain: Indlela kaNarae yahlukile kwixabiso elichanekileyo u-2 kuwo omabini amanani, ngoko ingxelo "ihlala isebenza" iyaphuka. Kodwa le theyibhile yodwa ayinakuqinisekisa "ayisebenzi naphi". Indlela kaGaon ibichanekile kwimizekelo emibini, kodwa ukuchaneka kwimizekelo akuthethi ukuba isebenza kuyo yonke imeko. Kufuneka usebenze isizathu.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.prompt: Ukuthi indlela kaGaon isebenza kuwo onke amanani axubeneyo, kuya kufuneka ubungqina obuthini ngaphandle kwemizekelo emibini etheyibhileni?
z-m-13-05.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa imeko apho ugcina umhlululi njengoko unjalo wahlule kuphela inani elihlulwayo nemeko apho wahlula umhlululi.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.o.a: Yenza imizekelo embalwa emininzi ngamanani amakhulu uze ubale ukuba indlela kaGaon ichanekile na.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.r.a: Nokuba kukho imizekelo emininzi, "zonke" ayiqinisekiswa. Imizekelo yomeleza kuphela ukholo.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.o.b: Indlela kaNarae ayichanekanga, ngoko indlela kaGaon kufuneka ibe nokuchanekile.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.r.b: Indlela ukungachaneki ayenzi enye indlela ichaneke. Kufuneka usebenze indlela kaGaon ngokwahlukeneyo.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.o.c: Sebenza ukuba kutheni isixa seziphumo zokwahlula zeenxalenye ezahlukanisiweyo silingana nesiphumo sokwahlula sesilonke.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.o.d: Buza utitshala ukuba indlela kaGaon ichanekile na.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.r.d: Kwakuya kuqinisekiswa, kodwa kwahlukile ekuzisebenzeleni wena ukuba kutheni.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.explain: Ukuba uyawahlula isahlulwa wongeze iziphumo zokwahlula inxalenye nganye ngomahluli ofanayo, silingana nesiphumo sokwahlula sesilonke ngalo mahluli ukususela ekuqaleni. Kwelinye icala, ukuba uyawahlula umahluli, esi sizathu asisebenzi.
